summary: Frontend E2E validation of 3 new features on LOGITRAK: (1) badge documents pending click, (2) archives page (list/expand/download) with delete-vehicle-guard, (3) superadmin cross-tenant document transfer via impersonation. 6/6 target flows PASS after resolving test-script URL typo (/vehicules FR, not /vehicles). RBAC visual checks (admin no-transfer, read_only no-badge no-transfer) confirmed. Backend guard 409 confirmed. Console clean (0 errors) on happy paths.
critical_code_review_comments: ArchivesPage: TableRow colSpan={7} used unconditionally for loading/empty but header has 6 cols for non-superadmin (superadmin=7). Cosmetic only, no visible impact.
TransferArchiveDialog: 'admin-overview' query enabled=open loads full overview when opening dialog; could be scoped to /api/admin/tenants list if payload heavy.
Route naming inconsistency: /vehicules (FR) vs /documents /archives (EN) — mixed lang in routes. Not a bug; may confuse future testers/scripts.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test archives via admin: E2E-ARC-6Y4I3F (1 doc, then transferred to Client Test E2E vehicle GE 100 200 — now count=0 with transferred badge) and E2E-ARC-MS2LBG (1 doc, kept). One doc now exists on GE 100 200 in tenant client-test-e2e with a_verifier=true (expected side-effect flagged in review request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: Vehicles page route is /vehicules (French), NOT /vehicles. The Layout nav link uses /vehicules. Direct goto /vehicles renders blank inside the app shell. Archives page route is /archives (EN). Archive rows expand-on-click; superadmin actions column only appears in Vue client mode (setActingTenant via admin-view-client-btn-{tenantId}). Tenant Select in TransferArchiveDialog displays tenant NAMES (e.g. 'Client Test E2E') not IDs — filter options by name. 2 archives remain in default tenant, one transferred one not.
